༄༅/ /drang srong gza'i bcos thabs kyi gdams pa rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /drang srong gza'i bcos thabs kyi gdams pa rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

mtshan dpes spras pa'i zhi sku yin nam 'jigs shing rngams pas de lta'ang min/ /drug cu'i dbyangs ldan zhi gsung yin nam hūṃ sgra sgrogs pas de lta'ang min/ /byams brtser ldan pa'i zhi thugs yin nam gdug pa skrag pas de lta'ang min/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yab tu gyur kyang sras kyi thu bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chu skyes las 'khrungs skyon dang bral yang snyigs dus skyo bo'i khrod na gnas/ /byams dang snying rjes bdag rgyud gtams kyang gdug pa 'dul phyir sprul pa ston/ /mi 'gyur chos kyi dbyings la bzhugs kyang gdul bya'i re ba sna tshogs skong*/ /padma 'byung gnas bla ma la btud nas/ /gza' rgod gso srung gdams pa 'bri/ /de la rtags dang bcos thabs srung ba gsum/ /dang po spyi dang bye brag khyad par rtags/ /spyi rtags kha mi g.yo zhing zha rengs skyugs/ /sbrid ber mgo na zi khol tsha zhing 'gyel/ /mig 'grib rna ba 'on zhing chal lam lkugs/ /mig rtsa dmar rgod 'phyo 'dar snying mi dga'/ / bshang gci 'chor bsdams gdong rtsa rtag tu 'phar/ /bye brag lus kyi g.yas na kha sna skam/ /drod che skom 'dod so dreg me ris 'byung*/ /zas skom zos nas na ba me yi gza'/ /lus kyi g.yon na drong chung grang 'brum 'ong*/ kha sna chu mang nyol bu zho grod 'dra/ /'dar dngangs so sgra so dreg che ba chu/ /gnyid che lus lci sha ser dang kha 'gag /sdod 'dod smra ba nyung ba sa yi gza'/ / gdong skya gnyid med g.yal mang skom nad chung*/ /mgo 'khor mtho dman byed cing shes pa 'phyo/ /gla bcol dran pa nyams pa rlung gi gza'/ /rna ltag rus 'bur mthe bos mnan mnyes shul/ /dmar thig byung ba me yin sngo ba chu/ /sen mo dmar ba me yin dkar ba chu/ khyad par spos dkar gangs thig sbyar ba la/ /phyag rdor sngags kyis byin rlabs khong du btang*/ /mgo bstum kho rang gi skra sen la tsha bsres pas bdug /gzer sbrid sha 'gul gang rung byung ba 'am/

/mig sprin sngar las 'gyur na nges par yin/ /yang na gangs thig nyung ma bye sgog pa/ /chu la thur mgo phyed sbyar khong du btang*/ /snying babs smyo lkugs snod babs 'khru dang bshal/ /mkhal mar babs na rgyun gnyis sdom byed cing*/ /mtsher babs gzhogs skams mdor na gang babs pa'i/ /nad de ldang 'gyur 'khrul med brtag thabs yin/ /yang na spos dkar spang spos sbang skam gro /bdug pas sha dmar kha sna skams na me/ kha sna'i chu mang sha sngo chu yi gza'/ /gla rtsi gu gul dkar nag mu zi nag /shu dag ldong ros drug po zhib btags la/ /g.ya' dang bral ba'i me long rgyab tu byug /oṃ tsu du a ya sha la ṇa swāhā/ zhes pa gsum bdun rdzas dang me long btab/ /dud pas bdug cing nad pas me long blta/ /dmar por mthong na me yin sngon po chu// ser po sa la dkar po lcags kyi gza'/ /ljang gu'i mdog mthong shing gi gza' ru 'dod/ /sha pags la babs kha mig gle kyog 'gro /rtsa rgyus la babs yan lag zha zhing rengs/ /snying la babs na dran nyams smra ba dka'// glo bar babs na glo 'ong skad 'gag cing*/ /mchin pa la babs khrag skyugs gzugs 'dzin 'grib/ /mtsher babs gzhogs sha skams shing kyog por 'gro /mkhal las rna ba 'on cing rtsa chu sdom/ /pho bar babs na skyugs shing rgyu mar 'khru/ /bsdong zla rgyal pos smyo zhing 'dud la zha/ /mig chu kha sna spu skyugs mgrin 'gags btsan/ /sman mos chags pa skye zhing shu dra 'chor/ /ma mos g.yang lhung khu ba bshang gci 'chor/ /srin mos lto 'phye gdong pa dri mi zhim/ /res dgod res ngu dgra lha'i rgyal po yin/ /dmu la pags pa 'bud cing sdug bsngal 'ong*/ /yan lag zha zhing kha yo sa bdag bsdongs/ /de ltar 'khrul med rtags kyis ngos bzung la/ /bcos thabs btson 'dzin dma' 'bebs byad 'grol dang*/ /spur dang ma bstan zhi dang sbyang ba 'o/ /de la dang po btson du gzung ba ni/ /oṃ be ta ri la gra mo tsan shig zung zung*/

zhes pa'i sngags 'di gu gul dkar nag la/ /btab pa'i chu de khong du btang bar bya//rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po'i bskyed rim bsgom/ /bsgrub bya mdun bzhag rang gi lag gnyis bsnol/ /g.yas pas g.yas dang de bzhin g.yon pa yi/ /srin lag gnyis nas gzung la 'di skad brjod/ /nga'i bka' ma byung zhing sprul pa dang sdong pa dang lam ma bstan gyi bar du zung zungs/ zhes pa dang*/ gang la babs pa'i gnas las gzhan du ma byer/ ma 'phro/ ma 'pho/ ma 'khyugs shig /ces pa lan gsum brjod pas zin par gnad che 'gyur/ gnyis pa dma' phab tsher ma can gyi shing*/ /gang 'dzom lung pa dgu yi chu sna dang*/ /'og gos ldan pa'i bu mo gtsang ma dang*/ /ra thag rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs bsag /rang gi mdun du phyar ba'i gdan gyi steng*/ /nad pa gcer bur bzhag la sngags 'di brjod/ /ke ta ke ta rā hu la mdun shig ya thum swā hā/ dor ma dron mos mgo g.yogs ra thag dkri/ /rol mo 'jigs pa tsham rngams sna tshogs bya/ /de nas dor ma ra thag bcas pa phob/ /'byung bzhi'i dpyad la snying ga mdun rgyab dang*/ /ltag pa rnams su chu lcag drag tu rdeg /de nas rim gyis lus kun khyab par rdeg /de nas tsher ma'i me yis mdun rgyab g.yug /rim gyis sas brab phyar ba'i sne bzhi nas/ /bteg cing g.yob pa rlung gi dpyad du 'gyur/ /slar yang gsar pa'i gdan gyi steng du bzhag /gsang ba'i gnas dpral mgrin snying gsum la sogs gang na'i gnas/ /sha ru'i tsong ke gser gyi rdo rje rtse lā par/ /bsams la gsang ba gshed 'bebs sngags kyis brdung*/ /dha rma dhā tu hūṃ/ spo ta ya spo ta ya/ bha smiṃ ku ru hūṃ/ baṃ dza rā hu la tsitta dun dun/ padma dza li dza rbad/ slar yang sngags brjod phyi ba bya rgod go /bya rog sram gyi lag pas rim bzhin brad/ /de dag ma 'byor ting 'dzin gsal pos bya/ /rnam 'joms khrus bya yon phul tshogs 'khor bsham/ /shis pa brjod cing smon lam legs par brjod/

/gsum pa byad 'grol rin chen snod kyi nang*/ /'o chus bkang zhing klu sman dar sna btab/ /dkyil du bag zan dag la sgra gcan gzugs/ /mgo gsum sbrul mgo dang bcas lag gnyis pa/ /sbrul 'jug smad 'khyil de'i mthar klu brgyad sbal lcang gzugs/ /snod bcug 'gal thag tshon skud khro bos mtha' ma bskor/ /sne mo nad pa pho yig g.yon dang mo yig g.yas/ /srin lag btags la sngags 'di brgya phrag drug /bzlas pa byas pa'i sngags chu khong du btang*/ / oṃ a tan sod/ mi tān sod/ du du sod bā gha li dhu ri pa sod swā hā/ slar yang sngags 'di bzla zhing 'gal thag bcad/ /dung shaṃ phaṭa pa shaṃ phaṭa/ pheṃ shaṃ phaṭa/ shar shaṃ phaṭa/ krag shaṃ phaṭa/ se shaṃ phaṭa/ tsa shaṃ phaṭa/ phur shi phaṭa/ sha shaṃ phaṭa/ krag sha tsa shaṃ phaṭaḥ ces dang*/ bi shwa dha na ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sbur ba'i skabs ltar 'byung bzhi'i dug sbur ram/ /'byung bzhi'i byad 'grol zhes sogs 'don pa bsgyur/ /'gal thag dum bu lung pa sogs chu nang dor/ /de dag 'bab chu'i rgyun nam ri ngos bskyal/ /bzhi pa spur la zhi drag gnad bskul dang*/ /rdzas dang srog chags la brten spur ba'o/ /dang po sngar bstan ba yi 'byung bzhi dang*/ /sha khrag gcan gzan ras ma byang mig dgu /gza' gzhu 'od ma gza' mda' 'ug pa dang*/ /me long rgya long gza' ra rog po dang*/ /gza' lug gan gdong dmar 'brang rgyas zhal dkar dang*/ /mda' dar dkar dmar 'bru sna dar sna rnams/ /re re 'ang dgu dgu gza' ra gza' lug sogs/ / rang nyid med na gzugs brnyan byas pa bsag /de nas ngur shaṃ phaṭa sogs brjod pa'i rjes/ /phyi 'byung ba bzhi'i dug spur ro/ /nang nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i dug spur ro/ /rkyang pa'i dug spur ro/ /'dus pa'i dug spur ro/ /ku re ltar zhugs pa'i dug spur ro/ /'jab bu ltar zhugs pa'i dug spur ro/ /rim gyis zhugs pa'i dug spur ro/ /gcig car zhugs pa'i dug spur ro/ /thod rgal zhugs pa'i dug spur ro/

/rku thabs su zhugs pa'i dug spur ro/ /sha la me ltar rgyas pa'i dug spur ro/ khrag la chu ltar 'brub pa'i dug spur ro/ / pags la me ltar 'bar ba'i dug spur ro/ /rtsa la rta ltar zhon pa'i dug spur ro/ /chu rgyus la sbrul ltar 'khril ba'i dug spur ro/ /don la wa ltar 'jab pa'i dug thams cad spur ro/ /zhes dang*/ gong gi rdzas dgu po re re nas/ gcan gzan ras ma 'dis spur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ 'bru sna dar sna dgu po 'dis spur ro/ /drang srong gza'i byad thams cad spur ro/ /bi shwa dha na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ gal te sul do ba sngo yang*/ / drang srong khyed la do mi bsdo/ /zhes zhi ba bya'o/ /drag pa spur ba mi lus dmag chas bsgyur/ /go gyon mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ khrab bsig pa yi stangs stabs kyis/ /jag pa'i tshul gyis bsdig par bya/ /sngags dang smon lam gong dang 'dra/ /gnad nas bskul te spur ba ni/ /bca' lugs gong dang 'dra ba la/ /sngags 'chang rnga brdung 'di skad brjod/ /nga ni gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong yin/ /yo khal bsrang ba'i thig shing gtad/ /dkar nag 'byed pa'i lde mig yin/ /da yang drang srong gdug pa khyod/ /mi yul 'di na yun ma ring*/ /mi yul gdug rtsub ngan thabs mang*/ /mi yul mi gtsang btsog gnas che/ /ro stod rnag khrag rdzing bu 'khyil/ /ro smad dri ngan bshang gci 'khyil/ /yan lag nya bzhi dbyug skam 'dra/ /skra dang smin ma nag rul 'dra/ / de la chags na drang srong min/ khyod ni 'dod khams lha yi lus/ /lus bzang 'di ru babs par mchi'o/ /la yogs 'phral du 'byung bar mchi'o/ /'gyod pa drag po skye bar mchi'o/ /drang srong rang gi yul du btsun/ /'ja' tshon nam mkha'i dbyings na bkra/ /yab yum gnas su la 'ur bzhud/ /ces gnad nas bskul te spur ro/ /rdzas dang srog chags dag gis spur ba la/ /rdzas bsags pa dang dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/

/rdzas la ra dug spyang brun rta nag bon/ /la cha shu dag khyi dkar sna dmar brun/ /btsan dug bdag med nag mo'i mngal khrag dang*/ /chig skyes gu gul sbyar ba zhag gsum bdug /dngos gzhi zangs gzhong 'o chus bkang ba'i nang*/ /nya chung btsud cing nad pa'i rna ba g.yon/ /gtad la gtum po la sogs 'dren du bcug /bla mas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon song bas/ /gsang ba'i bdag po'i bskyed rim gsal bar bsgom/ /sngags ring brgya dang gzhan yang drag sngags sogs/ /bgrangs la nad pa'i rna ba g.yas la rdeg /nad pa rang gis bsgom bya'i dmigs pa ni/ /bla ma gsang bdag gsal ba'i ba spu nas/ /phyag rdor phra mo 'od chags dpag med 'phros/ kha ba bab ltar spyi gtsug rkang mthil bar/ /lus nang gang ba'i 'od dang gzi brjid kyis/ / nad gdon thams cad rna ba g.yon pas thon/ /chu nang nya chu ngag la thim par bsam/ /de ltar byas pas rtags sogs 'phral du 'byung*/ /nya nyid nub 'dam kha dang phug ron byang du bskyal/ /rang nyid yin na gar gyi phyogs su bskyal/ /de rjes dor mas mgo bstums rdzas kyis bdug /lnga pa lam bstan 'brang rgyas zhal dkar dang*/ /rā hu'i gzugs bca' mda' dar dkar dmar thogs/ /sngags 'chang rnga brdung 'di skad drag tu brjod/ /drang srong gza' brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /de yang gnas 'dir yun ring bas/ khyod kyi pho brang 'degs re 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa la/ /drang srong lam bstan de ru bstan/ /dam chos bla ma spong ba la/ /drang srong lam bstan de ru bstan/ / chos mdzad dbu 'phang smad pa la/ /drang srong lam= kha drag dpung pa 'phyar ba la/ /drang srong = /theg pa khyad du gsod pa la/ /drang srong = /rmang mchog mthen la gnon pa la/ /drang srong = /sngags pa'i nor la 'phrog pa la/ /drang srong = /gza' gshegs pa de de ru gshegs/ /rgyu skar gshegs pa de ru gshegs/ /sngags 'chang nged kyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /sku tshe gza' dang mnyam par srings/

/bar chad ngan thabs gdug rtsub chod/ / bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /ces pas lam bstan to/ /bcos lugs lnga po kun gyi skabs su sngags sham bur/ rtsa sngags dregs pa can gyi sngags 'di bgrang*/ /oṃ thil thil/ phrum phrum/ shag shag /ghu ru ya tig nan/ rā hu la shig /rā hu la gtub/ rā hu g.yas su nan/ tsitta rbad nan/ tsitta rbad/ gdong mo bzhi po g.yon du/ zhes pa dang*/ me gza' 'joms pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma nan ig swā hā/ chu gza' 'joms pa'i sngags ni/ chu ti ma ni sod/ rlung gza' 'joms pa'i sngags ni/ byer ba phos so sod/ nam mkha'i gza' 'joms pa'i sngags ni/ dha ri ka ni sod/ sa gza' 'joms pa'i sngags ni/ sha na dha ti sod/ mgo na na/ oṃ krug dun swā hā/ mig na na/ oṃ sho kri pho phed zi zi hi ri hūṃ/ rna ba na na/ ko ling phra ma nan sod swā hā/ snying la bab/ na ro sol cig snying thog tu blan pa sbud pas spung*/ sngags ni/ oṃ shu kri kha tun phi ra la tsitta rgyas par mdzod cig /yan lag na na/ khug khug /shan shan/ shad shad/ sbe bu la nan swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ kha sna mig sogs yo bar gyur pa la/ sla nga chu 'bod man ngag bya ba ni/ 'chus pa'i phyos su sla nga chu yis bkang*/ ma 'chus phyogs su stong pa'i snod bzhag la/ nad pa 'chus pa de las bzlog pa yin/ /'chus pa mi gzugs chu yi nang du bzhag /nad pa rang gis chu rngubs stong pa'i snod du yang yang du/ /bskyar cing snod gsum ma zad bar du thang chad chad dor/ bar bya zag /yang yang rgyag la rten 'brel thur ma ni/ glud kyi khong par long ka 'am rgyu ma lta bu khrag bkang gzhug /gang na'i gnas sbyar nad pa dngos su bsam//lcags bsregs thur ma khrag ston brdeg pa zhal gdams yin/ /'di rnams dus su rang nyid yi dam bsgom/ /mdun rgyab na la phying ba mar btsos bslan/ /dbyug pas dal bus brdung pa zhal gdams yin/ /oṃ tuṃ phi li tuṃ pho li bī ltuṃ be ltuṃ me me su su shig shig swā

hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ke ta ke ta a pa ra tsakra hri sti rā hu la a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags gnyis dma' phab zhabs ma yi/ 'khor lo bskor dang drag pos spur pa'i skabs/ / rang dang grogs byed kun gyis bgrang bar bya/ khyad par rang gi rtsa sngags dregs pa can/ /gnas skabs kun tu bgrang ba zhal gdams yin/ /zhi sbyang gnyis las dang po zhi byed ni/ / ka ko ma gtogs pa'i bzang po lnga dang nal sha skyes pa gring gi gri bo'i sha /rta nag khrag dang bud med gring shi'i gri mo khrag rnams ni/ /lho sman lnga dang bod sman bzhi ru grags/ /mdze nag khrag tel khra zhes pa'ang 'dug sha khyi smyon mched ni nag po khra bo dkar po tshig thub gsum/ sgog bsregs bsres na nag sbyor ga bur dkar/ /te la sha khra bo gsum ka'ang khra bor 'gyur/ /ma 'brong bzang po lnga dang gri sha dang*/ /nal bu'i sha dang sgog bsregs nag sbyor te/ gsang ba las kyang ches gsang khong du btang*// mgo na gser mdog mig na zangs rtsi sdeb/ /sā lu'i ljang pa skyugs la da trig lga /'khru ba'i nad la 'o me la cu gung gi ghi hang bsil gsum sdeb/ /rlung la dzā ti shing la snying zho sha/ /sa la cu gur bra bo'i yos bog sdig /chu la tsi tra shing tsha nal sham ste/ /mgo bo zug bcas ru rta dur byid gnyis/ /mar dkar sbyar nas byug cing ka mig lo/ /btsod bsregs bul tog ra dkar 'o sbyar byug /chu bur rma byung g.yer ma'i byug pa bya/ /pha ni srin po ma klu gdong mo bzhi/ khyab 'jug dug rnams rim bzhin 'joms pa ni/ /srin bya'i klad pa zangs rdo gri khrag dang*/ /yugs sa'i mngal khrag zangs sder snod kyi nang*/ /bu ram mgo bsdus ril bu nas phyed tsam/ /phyag rdor sngags kyis byin brlabs

gso ba dang bsrung ba la/ tshes brgyad bco lnga nyer dgu'i dus su bsten/ /gso na bzhi brgyad bcu gcig bco brgyad nya/ /nyer gnyis nyer lnga nyer dgu rgyu dus brgyad/ /ril bu re re gu gul thang gis phul/ /rang srung ril bu zos pas ldog mi 'gyur/ /gzhan yang mnan gtad klu yi byad du bcug /sa bdag klu yi dug rnams 'di yis 'joms/ /nal sha pang khrag gi waṃ gangs tig dang*/ /gri snying srin bya'i sha dang nya yi mkhris/ /zangs rdo dngul chu gri khrag sgog bsregs thal/ /tel sha nā ga ge sar bzang po drug /a gar nag pos steng 'og gdon rnams 'joms/ /slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i man ngag las/ /bzang drug gi waṃ gla rtsi ba ru ra/ /cong zhi rnams kyis 'du ba spyi ru snyoms/ /sgog skya yugs sa'i dor rta bsregs pa'i thal/ /gza' dug me tog gsum pa nang gi sman/ /gri snying gri sha yugs sa'i mngal khrag dang*/ / nal bu te lo pu shud sre mong sha /pha gol 'di bdun gsang ba'i sman mchog yin/ /bkol grang dag gis phul nas btang par bya/ /yang na snyan brgyud zab mo'i spyi sman ni/ /sla nga'i steng du yugs sa'i dor rta'i steng*/ /sgog skya chig skyes du ba ma shor bsreg /zangs rdo srin bya'i klad pa gre khrag dang*/ / mngal khrag a ga ru dang bzang po drug /gza' dug dkar nag gu gul dkar nag dang*/ /gla rtsi a ru ra rnams sbyar la btang*/ /yang na padmas mdzad pa'i gnyis pa ni/ /bong nga gu gul bzang drug a ruu ra/ /gla rtsi shu dag ru rta te lo'i sha /yugs sa'i mngal khrag dor rta'i thal ba dang*/ /nal bu'i sha dang gri khrag btsod kyi khrag /gri snying gza' dug rma bya'i sgro mdongs sbyar/ / yang na thun mong min pa'i sman mchog ni/ /ya med sbrul nag gnyan thub big pan sgog bsregs ru rta dang*/ /shu dag gu gul spos dkar rta nag khrag /gri sha gri khrag dzā ti btsod kyi khrag /a ru ra rnams thun tshad re re ste/

/gla rtsi cha gcig zhib par btags pa de/ /ril bu sran tsam nam mkha' mi mthong bar/ /rten 'brel snying po gsang bdag snying po bzla/ /oṃ thil thil/ /phruṃ phruṃ/ shag shag /go ri ya de nan/ /rā hu la ru nan/ rā hu la rig khyung*/ sngags 'di bgrangs la ha yis gdab bya zhing*/ /ril bu phyag na rdo rjer bsgom par bya/ /rab gnas byas la par bu bzang por bcang*/ /dme pho sho re mdze yugs nyams pa can/ /de dag reg tu mi 'jug sman nus 'chor/ /chig brgyud zab mo'i ril bu khyad 'don 'dis/ /gza' nad kun las nges par grol ba yin/ /spos dkar cong zhi gser mdog sgog bsregs rnams/ /cha ni gsum re gla gul dzā ti rnams/ /cha re ka ra bzhi 'gyur chang gis phul/ /drang srong gza' yi nad las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /gla rtsi spang spos spyang brun dug gang 'dzoms sna tshogs/ /shu dag tsha grang chu dang mar sbyar byug /me gza' ga pur grang gza' drod sman bsnan/ /rkang lag rengs 'khums la sogs 'di yis grol/ /sbyong byed rnyings pa lus la zhen pa la/ /gang babs nad gzhi sbyar la rtsa ltos sbyang*/ /drang srong srung ba'i dge sbyor byed pa la/ /nyer dgu nas brtsams zla gcig mtshams bcad cing*/ /tho rengs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon btang nas/ /rang nyid phyag na rdo rje'i bskyed rim bsgom/ /de yi bzlas pa myur smad bar du bya/ /de nas nub tu kha bltas tha mal 'dug / mdun du sgra gcan dud kha mgo dgu pa/ / sum bsgribs nyis brtsegs steng du nyis bsgrigs gcig /de dbus bya rog mgo mtshan lag bzhi pa/ /dang po thal sbyar g.yas kyi gnyis pa na/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan ra yi mda' gzhu g.yon/ /lus kun mig gis gang ba gsal bar bsgom/ /rā hu la trig nan dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes spyan drangs dgug gzhug bstim/ /rang gi rgyab tu rus sbal shin tu che/ /de'i rgyab shin tu rwa rno'i glang dmar bsgom/ /de nas rang nyid rā hu la yis mid/

/rā hu la yang rus sbal dag gis mid/ /glang gis rus sbal rā huu la bsad nas//rang sems hūm̐ yig sngon por rgyangs kyis thon/ /de nyid gzung 'dzin bag chags dang bral ba'i/ /don gyi phyag na rdo rje legs par bsgom// lcang lo can nas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams/ / phyag rdor rnam pa dpag med spyan drangs bstim/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa yi// thugs kar hūṃ mthing sor bzhi pa yi mthar/ /oṃ nyi ma nan/ /zla ba nan/ klad pa nan/ snying mgo nan/ /gzhi rtse ltag khung nga nan/ oṃ tsi tra man tra zlog /nā ga shig /nā ga zlog /nā ga'i mgo la nan/ /bskor bar dmigs la srod bar brgya rtsa bzla /bco lnga bar du bcu phrag re re bsnan/ /de nas nyer dgu'i bar du bcu bcu phri/ /de ltar byas pas bskal par gnod mi 'gyur/ /rjes la smon lam shis brjod legs par bya/ / srung ba gcig rang nyid sgra gcan dud kha phyag gnyis pa/ / mgo dgu bya rog mgo bcas legs par bsgom/ /rā hu la ru dra a mṛ ta tṛ a ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa la sogs bzlas pa'i rjes/ /de zhu thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi par/ / bsgoms la ma ṇi ci tsam nus pa bzla/ /rjes bsngo 'di 'ang srung ba khyad par 'phags/ / yang gcig la/ oṃ kre kṣe baṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa tho rengs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ /sna bug phya yis btab pas nges par thub/ yang na sngags 'di gser gyis bris byas pa/ /rab gnas byas nas ske la btags pas thub/ / gza' nad srung ba'i man ngag dam pa ni/ /mu ne kye dmed dha phyo dza la'i bha skyo shar ni dman brad nan rgyu/ ghoḥn li khastaṃ tsa kri ho rbha re admanasarba nerba dzastartsarakra te tiṃḥshahaḥ sngags 'di gser gyis tshag med legs par bri/ / rtena'abrel snying po rgyab bri de nyid kyis/ /rab gnas byas pa mgul du btags pas thub/ /sho pa na ca khre du khre du phaṭaḥ /dus bzang bzhi la sngags 'di brgya stong bzla/

/ma grub blo la bzung bas srung ba'i mchog /'di yi lo rgyus g.yu brag pa nyid la/ /drang srong gnod pas mkhas zer kun la gtugs/ /phyi nas nyang stod snang gshen bon po gcig /sngags btags tsam gyis 'tsho bar 'dug ces thos/ /gser zho gang dang gos yug gcig bskur nas/ /gdams pa blangs pas bon pos 'di skad brjod/ /nga yi 'di la gser srang re yi yon/ /med par mi sbyin bka' rgya dam du spyod/ kho bos a tsa ra la zhus pa yin/ /'di la sman dang rten 'brel gzhan mi dgos/ /'di btags pa yis mi sel gcig kyang med/ /dam pa khyed la chad lhag med par 'bul/ /bla mas gser gyis bris nas btags pa yis/ / nad rnams rdul phyis bzhin du dag par gyur/ /yang lugs gcig la/ 'khor lo 'dogs na shog bu gtsang ma la/ /rtsibs lnga mu khyud nyis ldan rtsibs nang du/ /gtum po li bri rtsibs kyi mchan rnams la/ /a ya ma tri tu ti sha na la/ / phyi yi mu khyud rten 'brel snying po bri/ /nang gi u khyud nyi ma nan sogs bri/ /lte bar gang la gdags pa'i ming spel rkyang pa gzhug /gser gyis bris la rab nas spyi 'gro gdags/ /mtsho skyes la sogs rgya bod mkhas pas 'di gso ba dang srung ba'i gdams pa byas zin mod/ /'on kyang 'ga' yis dar gos blun po'i rkang par dkris ltar nyams par byas pa ma bzod nas/ /gso dang srung ba'i gdams pa mtha' dag dam pa'i snyan brgyud zhal shes ma lus rab bkod pa'i/ /dge ba gang des 'gro kun phyi nang sgra gcan gegs grol sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) drang srong gza'i bcos thabs kyi gdams pa rin chen phreng ba/ -PAGE 232--PAGE 243--PAGE 231-
